# Jota Fierro — Software Engineer

> Personal site and engineering portfolio of Jonathan "Jota" Fierro, a Sr.
> Backend Developer. The site itself is open source and is built with a
> spec-driven process: every feature ships with its functional spec, technical
> spec, QA report and review findings committed alongside the code.

The published process artifacts are the point, not a side effect — they are in
`.specs/` in the repository below.

## Site

- [Home](https://jotafierro.me/): single-page portfolio (EN/ES), React 19 + Vite.

## Projects

- [AURA](https://aura-dev.jotafierro.me/): a mythic real-life RPG powered by Karma.
- [j-flow](https://github.com/jotafierro/j-flow): gate-based Spec-Driven Development framework, distributed as a Claude Code plugin.
- [superclean](https://github.com/jotafierro/superclean): command-line utility for clearing macOS caches, logs and system trash.
- [me](https://github.com/jotafierro/me): the source of this site, including its specs and review history.
